items.headline: Trump Rejects Iranian Ceasefire Plan as Indirect U.S.-Iran Talks Resume
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has rejected a proposed seven-day ceasefire from Iran aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for sanctions relief. Despite the rejection, both nations confirmed on Monday that indirect diplomatic communications through mediators have resumed.

items.headline: SpaceX's Starship Achieves Earth Orbit for First Time in Historic Launch
items.summary: On September 28, SpaceX's Starship rocket reached Earth orbit for the first time during its 14th test flight, successfully deploying 26 Starlink satellites into space. The successful mission marks a critical milestone for global aerospace technology as NASA counts on the giant spacecraft for future human lunar landings.

items.headline: Breanna Stewart Powers Historic WNBA Playoff Upset Over Top-Seeded Lynx
items.summary: Breanna Stewart scored 34 points and grabbed 12 rebounds to lead the eighth-seeded New York Liberty to a 91-75 victory over the top-seeded Minnesota Lynx in Game 1 of the WNBA playoffs. The win marked the first time in WNBA history that a number eight seed defeated a top seed in a postseason matchup.

items.headline: Taylor Swift Becomes Most-Awarded Artist in MTV VMAs History
items.summary: Pop powerhouse Taylor Swift officially became the most-awarded artist in MTV Video Music Awards history at the 2026 ceremony. She broke her previous tie with Beyoncé by reaching 33 total career wins, accepting the inaugural Artist Director Honors and Video of the Year.
